def _tool_block(tools: list[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> str:
"""Render a tool catalogue as a textual list (for content-channel protocols)."""
if not tools:
return "(none)"
lines: list[str] = []
for spec in tools:
fn = spec.get("function") if "function" in spec else spec
name = fn.get("name", "<unnamed>")
desc = fn.get("description", "")
params = (fn.get("parameters") or {}).get("properties") or {}
sig = ", ".join(f"{k}" for k in params)
lines.append(f"- {name}({sig}) — {desc}")
return "\n".join(lines)

"""Strip ``<think>...</think>`` regions from a streaming chunk.
Preserves any visible content BEFORE ``<think>`` and AFTER ``</think>``
even if both tags appear in the same chunk. Returns

back into the next call so multi-chunk think blocks stay closed.

i = j + len("</think>")
in_think = False
else:
j = chunk.find("<think>", i)
if j == -1:
out.append(chunk[i:])
return ("".join(out), False)
out.append(chunk[i:j])
i = j + len("<think>")
in_think = True
return ("".join(out), in_think)
